owner: Codex: evidence, calculations and publication. Claude: contract selection and Lane B.

compatibility.lab_verdict: UNCHANGED legacy execution/audit field; never silently replaced by an Evening research route
compatibility.contract_symbol: UNCHANGED selected contract; no shadow selector activated
compatibility.contract_repair_current_state: Retained legacy field; the new consolidated selected-contract assessment is evening_assessment_json.contract_state. Do not confuse a retained historical repair flag with the new assessment.
compatibility.population: All rows retained, including longer-horizon, incomplete and unsuitable candidates
compatibility.receiving_side_acceptance: Claude must test population/order explicitly before changing Lane B filters

top_level_fields.evening_assessment_label: Human-readable label; not an execution instruction
top_level_fields.evening_assessment_reasons: Semicolon-delimited specific missing-input, identity, safety or contract-limit reason codes
top_level_fields.evening_assessment_warnings: Non-authoritative descriptive warnings; old repair flags remain visible
top_level_fields.evening_assessment_source_sha256: SHA256 of bound research input facts
top_level_fields.evening_assessment_json: Versioned full assessment JSON string; cards and full basket JSON preserve it

missing_publication: Absent fields mean this immutable revision predates the assessment. Do not infer a new status from lab_verdict.
unmatched_morning_identity: EVENING_NOT_ASSESSED with NO_UNIQUE_FROZEN_THESIS_MATCH; never ticker-only substitution

payload_fields.planned_trading_hold_sessions: Original governed planned hold; not DTE or assumed first-profit crossing
payload_fields.quote_timestamp_utc: Explicit timezone-aware quote timestamp, not a live quote-age guarantee
payload_fields.scenarios: Conditional checkpoint records, not probabilities or predicted paths
payload_fields.empirical_clock: A12 +20/+30 observations and counts; historical descriptive evidence, not an entry forecast
payload_fields.iv_intelligence: Saved selected-contract IV and available ATM/rank/percentile/history context; not proof of cheapness or profit

economics.exit: Model value less half quoted spread (or governed stressed multiple), less closing fee/100; no assumed sale below zero
economics.costs: Opening and closing fee once each, at the appropriate stage
economics.option_life: Actual remaining calendar days / 365 at each XNYS checkpoint, never 1.4 days per session
economics.pricing: Shared American CRR for US equity/ETF options; existing exercise-style policy for index exceptions
economics.rate_dividend: Published inputs with explicit supplied/fallback basis
economics.iv_stress: Existing governed 0.8x lower IV and reciprocal 1.25x higher IV; not ten percentage points
economics.slippage: Spread friction included; additional market impact/slippage unassessed, not silently claimed zero
economics.interpretation: Conditional outcomes, not expected returns or achieved fills. Invalidation timing, gaps and first-barrier order are not established.

quote_inventory.authority: Observed comparison inventory; no opposite-side thesis or contract choice is implied
quote_inventory.saved_replay: Separate exact-session Phantom inventory is supplied where original tested ladder lacks raw sides/IV. It is explicitly NOT reconstructed original selection evidence.
quote_inventory.missing: Null stays null. No midpoint-derived bid/ask or proxy IV. Truncation and scope must remain visible.

claude_acceptance: Use the isolated replay runs directory named in REPLAY_RECEIPT.json, not the live data/output/runs directory
Build handoff and verify no empty population or unintended ordering change
Run triage prefill and trade preparation against the same replay revision
Exercise manual-selection receive using the full frozen JSON, retaining exact identities
Compare card versus receiving-side contract, time basis, net dollars and returns for identical cases
Report receiving-side PASS or concrete field mismatches; do not modify the replay or live snapshots
entry_validation: Morning versus Lane B ownership remains undecided. Existing trigger_rules_v1.json is not modified; do not add a daily-close-only entry rule.
